QUESTIONS

Asked frequently, answered once.

How does billing in hours actually work?

At the end of each cycle, Meridian reviews the time it saved you and retains a small portion — four hours, on the Professional plan. The deduction is made from time you were not using: the minutes between meetings, the hour before you wake, the long part of a Sunday afternoon.

Your balance is shown in Settings, under Billing, under the total you remember agreeing to.

Why does February have 31 days in Meridian?

It doesn't, officially. February has the number of days it needs. In 2027, several of our customers had a great deal scheduled, and the month accommodated them. The 29th and 31st are ordinary working days. The second 30th is a Thursday.

Can I cancel my account?

Of course. Cancellation is available at any time from Settings, and takes effect at the start of your current billing cycle. Most people find, when they go to cancel, that they already have — and that things have been running more smoothly since.

Who is Elena Voss?

Elena is the founder of Northwind and one of our earliest customers. She has been kind enough to share her experience with Meridian on several occasions, most recently this November, and first in 1897. She is 34. She remains available for reference calls on request.

What happens to my data if I leave?

Your events are exported in full and your account is closed. Your past events remain in the calendars of everyone you met with, which is where they mostly live anyway. Meridian keeps nothing. Meridian has never needed to keep anything.
